tenderSchedule.title: KPLC-SUPPLY OF MANPOWER
tenderSchedule.locationName: Karnataka Public Lands Corporation Limited Director Office

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have a minimum eight years of experience in providing manpower services of Graduates to Government utilities including executive posts, in Karnataka and single contract of employees not less than 200 and more. Purchase order or DWA and successful project completion certificate or a combination of the above shall be uploaded as evidence.

The Bidder must have executed the Project with any of Karnataka directly or as sub contract with minimum strength not less than 250 or more numbers of manpower and the award must be in a single Project. Purchase order or DWA and successful project completion certificate or a combination of the above shall be uploaded as evidence.
The bidder shall be a company, registered under Companies Act, 1956 and should be in business for a period more than 15 years.
The bidder should have a valid Registration certificate of Establishment issued by the Department of Labour, Government of Karnataka. i.e Form C Number of Manpower not less than 300 & more.

The Service Providers should have valid registration certificate issued by the Statutory Authorities i.e., Income Tax, GST, Provident Fund, ESI, Commercial Tax, Labour and other Authorities to carry out the business of providing Human Resources on outsource basis to the Central / State Govt. Depts, Boards/ Corporations. The scanned copy of the same shall be enclosed to the technical bid as proof.

The Bidders should be a holder of valid labour license for at least 50 employees and should have an ISO-9001-2015 certificate obtained from appropriate authorities. The scanned copy of the same to be enclosed to the technical bid for evidence
The bidder shall not be blacklisted by any Government agencies/Utilities/Departments at the time of bidding. A self-declaration by the Bidder as per format Specified shall be uploaded

The Bidders should be holding the following and submit the copies as shown in Annexure I, Technical Bid Tenderer profile. a.Form C issued by Labour Department, b.ISO-9001-2015 Certificate. c.GST registration number, GSTR-3B returns with paid receipt, d.GSTR-9 & GSTR-9C returns, e.P T Registration Certificate along with copies of the latest returns, f.PAN of the Proprietor / Firm / Company, g.Income Tax Returns for the last 2 (Two) years, h.Annual Turnover Certificate certified by the C A (with UDIN), i.P & L and Balance Sheet certified by the C A, j.ESI Registration Certificate along with of ESI returns, k.EPF Registration Certificate and EPF returns l.Work Orders of man power service of Single work issued by Central / State Govt Depts, Boards/ Corporations.

The Bidders on whom work order is placed and subsequently canceled by any Central / State Govt. Depts, Boards/ Corporations in the last 5 years due to un-satisfactory performance are not eligible to apply. The scanned copies of previous three years experience certificate and satisfactory certificates obtained from Central / State Govt. Depts, Boards/ Corporations should be enclosed to the technical bid
